office_does: The three county commissioners are Asotin County's legislative and executive body: they adopt the budget and run county roads, buildings and the jail.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Commissioner Chuck Whitman is the only candidate; District 3 nominated him in the primary and the whole county elects him in November.

candidates.summary: Asotin County Commissioner for District 3, elected unopposed in 2020 and 2022, running unopposed again.
highlights: Cites unfunded and underfunded state requirements and cost-efficient services [S1]
Pledges to keep fighting for veterans' benefits [S1]
